practiceReport.name: Caleb Lohner
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: 21-day IR practice window open (Week 1); awaiting current-week practice ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: The Broncos opened Lohner's 21-day practice window Wednesday. The tight end is not quite ready to make his season debut, as he is still tending to his recovery from a foot injury he sustained in the offseason. Lohner was a full participant in all three Week 11 prep sessions, meaning his odds of returning in Week 12 are quite good if he can continue to log full sessions.

practiceReport.name: Talanoa Hufanga
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (93% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Hufanga logged three consecutive full practices during Week 11 prep. The strong safety did not let his persistent ankle injury inhibit him during the week, clearing him of any injury designation that may have followed him into Sunday's contest.

practiceReport.name: Riley Moss
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (75% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Moss was a full participant in Friday's practice. The newly extended Broncos starter has cleared the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and is all set to suit up for Sunday's contest. The team's Week 10 bye helped Moss rest and recover from the injury he sustained during the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers.

practiceReport.name: Kris Abrams-Draine
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The cornerback was a limited participant Wednesday. Abrams-Draine had to miss the Broncos' win over the Panthers in Week 9 ahead of the team's Week 10 bye. Now that he's had a week off to get healthy, he appears ready to play Sunday against Las Vegas.

practiceReport.name: Adam Prentice
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: It appears Prentice entered the league's concussion protocol following the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers. He had additional time to recover courtesy of the Week 10 bye, so the veteran fullback should be available for Sunday's AFC West tilt against the Raiders.
